ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Sideloading by VMware Xfer Utility
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of VMware Xfer utility (VMwareXferlogs.exe) from the non-default directory which may be an attempt to sideload arbitrary DLL

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\VMwareXferlogs\\\.exe$") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\VMware\\\\"))
